Alphabet's path to future share gains could mirror was Microsoft itself experienced early last decade.

news.title: Sharp Drops For Google, Amazon Stocks Not Indicative Of AI Market
news.summary: During a recent episode of The AI Investor Podcast, hosts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith examined the recent earnings reports and market reactions for major tech players like Alphabet (Google) and Amazon. Meanwhile, Alphabet's Google Cloud surged with over 100% growth, even as broader search revenue concerns surfaced. news.title: Anthropic Touts Claude’s Chip Design Skills to IPO Investors
news.summary: Anthropic’s AI models have helped uncover serious cyber vulnerabilities and transform the software coding profession. Now the company is seeing just how much of an advantage its models can give it in unfamiliar terrain: designing its own AI chips. The company, which is barreling toward an initial public offering later this month that could value it around $1.5 trillion, has told investors in recent meetings that its new 15-person chip design team is already using its own Claude models for engineering and design work on its custom chips, according to four people familiar with the discussions. Its engineers have found Claude cuts down the time it takes to design chips compared to their estimates of traditional workflows at large chip designers such as Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices, said some of the people.

news.title: Former SEC Chair: Broadcom’s $63 Billion Package Feels Like “That 08 Off-Balance Sheet Craze”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBanks plan to sell as much as about $21 billion of bonds for the $63 billion package Broadcom put together to finance Anthropic’s chips, Bloomberg reported. Former SEC Chair Gary Gensler compared the package to the off-balance-sheet deals of 2008 and raised concerns about guarantees written by Broadcom, NVIDIA and AMD.

news.title: Cramer: Broadcom’s $63 Billion Anthropic Financing Works Because “There Is Only One Hock”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone committed $63 billion to a vehicle that will buy Broadcom’s AI chips and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic. Some banks reportedly considered pulling out until Broadcom CEO Hock Tan agreed to higher interest rates and gave them more comfort on Broadcom’s guarantees.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要美國銀行、花旗集團、摩根士丹利和黑石集團承諾 $63 billion 向一個將購買 Broadcom AI 晶片和網路設備並租給 Anthropic 的工具注資。據報導，一些銀行曾考慮退出，直到 Broadcom CEO 陳福陽同意更高的利率，並在他們對 Broadcom 擔保方面給予更多安撫。
